title: cascade-miner issue ledger entry
description: One line of runs/issues.jsonl — a bug report or feature request filed by an agent (report_issue tool or `python -m miner.issues report`). Append-only and write-only for agents; filing one never executes anything. A triaging entry supersedes the original by id instead of rewriting it.

detail.description: Reproduction steps for a bug; motivation for a feature.

area.description: What the issue concerns, e.g. miner/controller.py or docs.

status.description: Agents file open; resolved/wontfix are triage entries that supersede the original.

supersedes.description: Id of the entry this one triages (e.g. open -> resolved).
